question: Do they experiment with other tasks?
title: Named Entities in Medical Case Reports: Corpus and Experiments
answer_rationale: The document mentions that the Multi-Task Learning model jointly trains two objectives: NER and Relation Extraction (RE), indicating experimentation with other tasks beyond the main NER task. Additionally, Text 5 and Text 7 mention the corpus enables tasks like Named Entity Recognition, Relation Extraction, and (sentence/paragraph) relevance detection, suggesting other tasks are considered.
